raw_segments.text: Regarding the sperm whale's head as a solid oblong, you may, on an inclined plane, sideways
divide it into two coins, whereof the lower is the bony structure, forming the cranium
and jaws, and the upper an unctuous mass wholly free from bones, its broad forward end forming
the expanded vertical apparent forehead of the whale.
